g.text: BASE WELDMENT (FIXED, ON THE DRUM RIM)
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-304 Drum-top vibratory sifter (built in house) · rev B
Product contact: 2B sheet, #4 polish Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967 (skirt, upstand ID)
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5
Ø9 THRU at 60° on R330 [12.992] (bond strap H5)
inside face on R293.5 [11.555] (drum rim R292 + 1.5)

svg.text: 0° = +x (vibrator side), angles CCW seen from above
SEAT UNDERSIDE (sits on the rim): flat 1.0 after welding
DETAIL D (1:1): JOINTS AT THE INNER EDGE
Upstand to seat top, both sides
fillet 2 out, seal + grind in (product side)
Skirt to seat underside, both sides
fillet 2 out, seal + grind in; skirt round ±1
ground flush both sides, no crevice
fillet 3 both sides x 40; inner faces on R293.5 ±0.5
1. Weld the rings round, then fit to the seat on a flat table; tack 8 places each, weld in short alternating runs to keep the seat flat 1.0.
2. Tabs last, on a drum rim gauge (Ø584): the base must drop on and lift off a drum freely with ≤ 2 mm play.
3. Passivate after welding. Product-contact surfaces: skirt ID, upstand ID, seat inner edge.
